info.name: SplitEase API
info.description: All 29 SplitEase endpoints. Run Auth > Register (or Login) first: it stores x-access-token / x-refresh-token from the response HEADERS into collection variables. Then run Groups > Create group, Expenses > ..., etc. in order; ids are captured automatically.

request.description: Tokens come back ONLY in the x-access-token / x-refresh-token response headers.
Rotates the pair. Re-sending an old refresh token revokes the session (401 REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED).
